_about: Shot sheet for main-story: the scenes in reading order, each with its shots in order. Every shot carries the previous shot's state forward (wardrobe, hair, accessories, marks, what each person carries); only a change with a reason alters it. A new story day starts again from the cards. Characters are tokens, props are ids; the compiled block (node scripts/compile-shot.mjs <scene>) writes the words.

porch.look: a narrow front porch at night, one yellow bulb over the door, a dead fern in a pot

kitchen.look: a small galley kitchen, chipped green tiles, one lamp over a square table

workshop.look: a carpenter's workshop, a long workbench under a hanging bulb, offcuts stacked against the wall

characters.action: reads the message again under the bulb
characters.position: left, one step back from the door

characters.action: digs through her bag for her keys

changes.reason: indoors now; the coat went over the back of her chair between scenes

characters.action: sits at the table with the phone face up in front of her
fills the kettle at the sink
reads the message one more time, thumb hovering over the keyboard

changes.reason: "Send it and see." {{chloe-jenkins:first}} takes the phone to type the reply herself

characters.action: types with both thumbs, glasses pulled down onto her nose
watches with both hands flat on the table
turns his phone face down on the workbench and goes back to sanding

shots._notes: the key is in frame on the bench, not in his hand: props lists it, holding does not
